source: Downloads/fd121c814e014601a8b89c32c32a7b46.MP4 (@alekseitalksai, OpenMontage, AirDropped 12 Oct 2026). 720x1280, 30 fps, HEVC, 31.2 s, AAC 44.1 kHz stereo (speech to 29.35 s). Copy in _source/kinetic-card-explainer-openmontage.MP4 (gitignored).
method: ffmpeg scene detection, full-frame difference at 30 fps, caption-band masks, pixel sampling of backgrounds and ink, local Whisper for word times, ebur128 loudness, frames viewed in 4 fps contact sheets and at full size.

layout.scene_area: y 0.08 to 0.62 of the height, centred

split.edge: soft 3 percent gradient from the background colour into the head picture

layout.head_cutin: full frame talker, caption centred at 0.69

shots.cut_type: all hard single frame cuts (19 of 20, one 3 frame)
scenes_in_order: dark: stat pill, logo, arrow, mascot

palette.order: dark, light, dark, light, terracotta, dark, light, dark, beige, dark, light, head, light, dark, beige, head, light, dark, split, card

captions.font_sans: bold grotesk (Inter or SF Pro Bold look), weight 700, about 47 px at 720 wide, text height 34 px
captions.accent_font: italic Didone serif (Playfair Display Italic look), about 1.17x the sans, colour #3BADDD, one noun per chunk
captions.chunk: 1 to 2 words, hard swap on the first word, no animation
captions.head_cutin_style: serif italic white (2 lines max), closing words in bold light blue, built up through the phrase
captions.end_card: comment in italic serif black, KEYWORD in bold italic serif #26B2F1 about 0.17 of the width per cap height, 'and I will send you the link' italic, 'and a setup guide' bold sans

motion: elements spring in with overshoot (pills and mascot), arrows draw along their length, waveforms animate, cards rise with a slight tilt; no transitions between scenes
mascot: orange pixel creature, white on terracotta, appears in most scenes

end.note: the dim and the Instagram glyph are the platform end screen, the comment card before it is part of the edit

audio.sound_effects: none (2 non-speech onsets at 27.5 s, the end)
